root_cause: The LLM accuracy CPU tests fetch model weights from HuggingFace during test setup. The CI runner IP (4.155.215.89) hit the HuggingFace anonymous API rate limit (429 Too Many Requests, 0/500 requests remaining). This is an external service constraint unrelated to the PR's code changes (which only touched src/core/src/op/constant.cpp and src/core/tests/constant.cpp).
reproduction_steps: N/A — rate limit is transient and IP/time-dependent.
recommended_actions: Configure HF_TOKEN in CI secrets to authenticate with HuggingFace and avoid anonymous rate limits.
Pre-cache model weights in CI or use a local model mirror to avoid on-demand downloads.
Re-run the failed job — the rate limit window expires and the next attempt will likely succeed.
prevention_strategies: Set HF_TOKEN in GitHub Actions secrets for the LLM accuracy test jobs to use authenticated HuggingFace API access, which has a much higher rate limit.
historical_context: Same pattern (391fe92c2ec33482) observed previously on 2026-08-27T16:46:44Z in run 33081710335 (PR #37616). Second occurrence same day.
